heroBody: Automatically detect sensitive information. Choose how it appears with 4 different masking methods.

openSource.title: Open source. Local-first.
openSource.body: Run DeID in your own environment. Detection uses deterministic rules and on-device NER, then human review before export.
openSource.unavailable: Repository link is not configured yet

uploadBody: DeID analyzes the document on your device to identify information such as people, organizations, addresses, contact details, identifiers and legal references.

localScan.privacy: Your document is not shared with external AI services during scanning.
localScan.reviewHint: You can review the findings and make any necessary changes before downloading the document.
localScan.needFile: Upload your document to start the scan.
localScan.needLanguage: Select the document language to start the scan.

uploadNotice.title: Important
uploadNotice.body: DeID helps identify and mask sensitive information. Automated detections may be incomplete or inaccurate. Review the results before sharing your document.
uploadNotice.disclaimer: This tool does not provide legal advice and does not, by itself, guarantee compliance with the GDPR, KVKK, or other data protection regulations.

documentLanguage.label: Document Language
documentLanguage.help: Select the language of your document.

demo.methodsSummary: Hide completely · Replace with label · Show initials · Mask partially

local.title: Local-first
local.body: Documents are processed in your own environment by default.

model.title: On-device detection
model.body: Deterministic rules and local NER run in your environment.

control.title: User-controlled
control.body: You decide how detected information is transformed.

footer.legal: DeID assists with document redaction and de-identification. It does not provide legal advice or, by itself, guarantee compliance with the GDPR, KVKK, or other data protection laws.

privacyBody: When processing finishes, the redacted file is saved in the “outputs” folder in the application directory.
profileHelp: The profile influences redaction recommendations. It does not decide which law applies and is not a compliance determination.
customProfileHelp: A custom profile turns off automatic redaction recommendations. You choose which categories to protect.
whatToProtect: What do you want to protect?
methodsRailBody: Permanent masking places a black box over the text. The document stays in the center in its original page layout.
methodsRailTipHover: Hover a mask to see the text underneath.
methodsRailTipClick: Click a mask to remove it; click again to restore it.
reviewNext1: Black boxes on the document are items that will be hidden.
reviewNext2: Hover a box to see the text underneath.
reviewNext3: Click a wrong box to remove it. Click again to restore it.
reviewNext4: You can also choose from the list on the right. When ready, press Apply masking.
reviewDocHint: Black boxes will be hidden. Hover a box to read the text; click to remove it, click again to restore it.
reviewListHelp: Checked items become black boxes on the document. Uncheck anything that should stay visible.
emptyDetections: No information was found to hide automatically.
emptyCompleteHint: We still recommend reviewing the document manually.
emptyPartialHint: This result does not mean the document contains no sensitive information.
inspectorHint: Select a detection in the document or list to see details.
manualPlaceholder: Exact text as it appears in the document
manualMatchHelp: All matches hide every copy of the same text. The page number locates the text in multi-page documents.
label: Replace with label
transformHelp: What should be protected, and how should it appear in the final document?
maskHoverHint: Hover a mask to see the text underneath. Click to remove it; click again to restore it.
selectModeHint: Select any text in the document to manually add it to the redaction list.
contextualRewriteHelp: Contextual rewrite is AI-assisted; every suggestion requires your review.

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.possibleMatchHint: These may refer to the same person.
workspace.possibleMatchHintAddress: These may refer to the same address.
workspace.customSearchHint: Search the document for a word / phrase
workspace.customSearchLead: Search the document for a phrase you want to hide.
workspace.customSearchApplyFailed: This phrase could not be added. Check the text and try again.
workspace.customSearchUnavailable: Custom detection is not available for this document.
workspace.foundHint: Checked items will be hidden. Uncheck to leave the text as it is. Change the hiding method on the category row.
workspace.phraseHitsHelp: Every line that contains this phrase is listed. Choose which ones to detect and how they should be hidden.
workspace.phraseHitEmpty: This phrase was not found in the document.
workspace.drawRedactHint: Draw a rectangle on the document to hide it. Press Esc or click outside the document to cancel.
workspace.drawTextHint: Draw a rectangle to place replacement text. Press Esc or click outside the document to cancel.
workspace.selectTextHint: Select the text you want to hide in the document.
workspace.manualLead: How should the selected area appear?
workspace.redactHelp: The area is covered with a colored box. Text underneath cannot be read.
workspace.addTextHelp: The selected area is covered, and your text is written over the hidden content.
workspace.initialsFontSizeHelp: The document font size could not be read. Initials will use Times New Roman at this size.
workspace.maskingPreferencesHelp: These defaults apply to every finding of that type. You can still override a single finding from its row menu.
workspace.toggleMaskHint: Click a finding, then change how it appears from the panel. Undo steps back through each change you made.
workspace.resizeDetectionHint: Click the detection to resize its frame.
workspace.resizeDetectionActive: Drag the edge points to adjust the frame. Clicking elsewhere clears the selection.
workspace.hideAllMatches: Hide the same text in this document
workspace.occurrenceHelp: This value appears {{count}} times in the document.
workspace.manualMergeSelect: Select a person to merge with
workspace.manualMergeEmpty: There is no other person to merge with.
workspace.manualMergeRoleConflict: Conflicting legal roles were merged as a generic person tag.

noEntities: No information was found to hide automatically.
docxRebuildNotice: For security, Word output is rebuilt from clean text only; original formatting and images are not retained.
error: The operation could not be completed
exportPassBody: {{count}} findings were processed with the methods you chose.
exportReadyBody: {{count}} findings were processed with the methods you chose.
exportPartialTitle: Output was created, but contextual analysis could not be completed.
exportPartialBody: Review the document manually before sharing it.
exportWarnBody: The output was created, but some results require manual review.
exportFailBody: The output file could not be created. Go back to this work and try again.
noApplyWithoutSelection: Export is unavailable until at least one item is selected to hide.

preset.label: Purpose
preset.help: Sets category defaults for this document. Your row-level exceptions are kept.
preset.ANONYMIZEDHelp: Identifiers are closed; names become labels or roles. Court names and similar structure stay.
preset.DETECT_ONLYHelp: Findings are highlighted but not transformed until you choose a method.

customTermHomonymHint: Text matching catches every occurrence; it cannot tell two people with the same name apart.
autoSaved: The output was also saved automatically to:
noGuarantee: This tool does not guarantee anonymisation or regulatory compliance.
